summary: Otis Worldwide filed an 8-K reporting the November 5, 2026 issuance of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 5.825% Notes due November 5, 2036, under its February 2026 Form S-3ASR shelf via a November 4 Rule 424(b)(2) prospectus supplement. Underwriting was led by Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and HSBC; net proceeds are estimated at roughly $495.3 million, intended with cash on hand to repay at maturity the $500 million of 2.293% notes due April 5, 2027. Structurally this is an ordinary debt shelf takedown and refinancing, not a special situation. Watch rate-reset economics and leverage rather than event arbitrage.
